name: reset-posture
title: Reset the posture
description: Return to the home posture: fingers open, arm folded, torso up, waist straight, by a collision-checked joint-space move. Used to recover from an unknown arm state.
use_when: Start or end of a task, or after a failure, to return to a known posture.

not_to_be_confused_with.tuck: tuck only folds one arm; reset also restores torso and waist.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: arm_stowed
postconditions.meaning: The arm is folded at its travel posture.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: torso_raised
postconditions.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: waist_straight
postconditions.meaning: Waist pitch within 0.05 rad of upright.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: arm_stowed
checks.meaning: The arm is folded at its travel posture.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: torso_raised
checks.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: waist_straight
checks.meaning: Waist pitch within 0.05 rad of upright.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

next.when: after a failed manipulation, before driving on
next.reason: a known posture makes the base path plannable

alternative.when: the arm and waist must also be restored
the arm and torso must also be restored

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
